name: background-work
about: a background shell, then a background agent, each keep the robot out past their turn's end until their report's turn ends

steps.prompt: /robovac Use the Bash tool with run_in_background set to true to run exactly: sleep 20 . Do not wait for it or check on it. Then reply with only the word launched.

Call the Agent tool once with subagent_type "general-purpose", run_in_background true, and this prompt: "Use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 15. Then reply done." Do not wait for it. Reply with only the word launched.
